Name: Koulto's Electric Bikes
Author: Koulto
Description:
[b][size=5]ABOUT
[/size][/b]-This mod replaces the horses in the game for an electric bike
-There's 6 styles to choose from.
-The Icons in the player menu changes too, showing the style of your bike instead of a horse.

[b][size=5]UPDATE[/size][/b]
-Now your stable will also change to become a garage. So far it only matches the default farm house but I will make different colors later in another update.

[b][size=5]HOW TO INSTALL[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of Content Patch.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the download folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game so a config file be created, then close it.[/size]
[*][size=2]Open the config file to change the style of your bike, use the reference image to know the correct name of each style.[/size]
[/list][/b]
This is my very first mod, and I am already planning to polish and add new styles, if you wish an specific color/style don't forget to comment it :)

Downloads.Description: -Added a garage which replaces the old stable, helping in immersion

Manifest.Name: Koulto's Electric Bikes
Manifest.Description: A CP replacement that turns your horse into an electric bike and your stable into a garage!
